product_name: Managed Service for Microsoft Active Directory

features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD can be deployed in the africa-south1 (Johannesburg) region; Managed Microsoft AD can be deployed in the europe-west10 (Berlin) region.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD can be deployed in the africa-south1 (Johannesburg) region; Managed Microsoft AD can be deployed in the europe-west10 (Berlin) region.

features.feature_name: Workforce identity federation for Managed Microsoft AD
features.feature_summary: Workforce identity federation is generally available for Managed Microsoft AD.
features.extended_definition: Workforce identity federation is generally available for Managed Microsoft AD.

features.feature_name: Automated domain join for Managed Microsoft AD
features.feature_summary: Windows Compute Engine VMs can join a Managed Microsoft AD domain automatically, with support for the managed-ad-force and managed-ad-ou-name flags, and GKE Windows Server nodes are also supported; Windows VMs can join a Managed Microsoft AD domain automatically in Preview.
features.extended_definition: Windows Compute Engine VMs can join a Managed Microsoft AD domain automatically, with support for the managed-ad-force and managed-ad-ou-name flags, and GKE Windows Server nodes are also supported; Windows VMs can join a Managed Microsoft AD domain automatically in Preview.

features.feature_name: Managed Microsoft AD audit log event IDs
features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD domain audit logs now include a new set of exportable event IDs.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD domain audit logs now include a new set of exportable event IDs.

features.feature_name: Microsoft security baselines for Managed Microsoft AD VMs
features.feature_summary: You can apply Microsoft security baselines to Managed Microsoft AD VMs.
features.extended_definition: You can apply Microsoft security baselines to Managed Microsoft AD VMs.

features.feature_name: Schema extensions for Managed Microsoft AD
features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD supports schema extensions.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD supports schema extensions.

features.feature_name: User migration to Managed Microsoft AD
features.feature_summary: You can migrate users from an existing domain to Managed Microsoft AD, including on-premises domains with SID History.
features.extended_definition: You can migrate users from an existing domain to Managed Microsoft AD, including on-premises domains with SID History.

features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD protects instances with the operating system's built-in antivirus.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD protects instances with the operating system's built-in antivirus.

features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD supports multi-project access through domain peering.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD supports multi-project access through domain peering.

features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD supports enabling LDAPS from the Google Cloud console; Managed Microsoft AD supports LDAPS.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD supports enabling LDAPS from the Google Cloud console; Managed Microsoft AD supports LDAPS.

features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD supports extending the directory schema.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD supports extending the directory schema.

features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD supports backing up and restoring domains.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD supports backing up and restoring domains.

features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD is available in additional regions.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD is available in additional regions.

features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD supports tags on domains.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD supports tags on domains.

features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD supports audit logging; Managed Microsoft AD supports audit logging.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD supports audit logging; Managed Microsoft AD supports audit logging.

features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD supports integration with Cloud SQL.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD supports integration with Cloud SQL.

features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD supports fine-grained password policies.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD supports fine-grained password policies.

features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD supports creating instances with Terraform.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD supports creating instances with Terraform.

features.feature_summary: The service published a service-level agreement for Managed Microsoft AD.
features.extended_definition: The service published a service-level agreement for Managed Microsoft AD.

features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD can be configured with VPC Service Controls for additional security.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD can be configured with VPC Service Controls for additional security.

features.feature_name: Default domain functional level for new domains
features.feature_summary: New Managed Microsoft AD domains default to the Windows Server 2012 R2 domain functional level.
features.extended_definition: New Managed Microsoft AD domains default to the Windows Server 2012 R2 domain functional level.

features.feature_summary: Managed Microsoft AD supports deploying domain controllers in multiple Google Cloud regions.
features.extended_definition: Managed Microsoft AD supports deploying domain controllers in multiple Google Cloud regions.

features.feature_name: Domain controllers in up to four regions per domain
features.feature_summary: Domain controllers for the same AD domain can be deployed across up to four regions.
features.extended_definition: Domain controllers for the same AD domain can be deployed across up to four regions.

features.feature_name: Multi-regional VPC access to domain controllers
features.feature_summary: AD-dependent VMs and applications can use multi-regional VPCs to reach domain controllers in any supported region.
features.extended_definition: AD-dependent VMs and applications can use multi-regional VPCs to reach domain controllers in any supported region.
